name: code-review
description: Reviews changes in the langchain-azure monorepo using package-specific knowledge of langchain-azure-ai, langchain-azure-compute, langchain-azure-cosmosdb, langchain-azure-postgresql, langchain-azure-storage, langchain-sqlserver, and langchain-azure-dynamic-sessions, together with the LangChain, LangGraph, Deep Agents, and Azure SDK contracts each package must satisfy. Use this skill whenever reviewing a pull request or diff, checking code for bugs or regressions, or assessing changes under libs/, samples/, or .github/ in this repository, including when the request is only to "review", "check", "look at", or "give feedback on" a change, and even when no package is named explicitly.
